_schema.note: Gate-2 golden-prompt acceptance fixture. One case per line; the _schema line is metadata and is skipped by the runner. Cases assert routing outcomes against the real TS scorer (scoreAdvisorPrompt) run in the pinned force-local regime, plus compiled-mode via compiled-route.cjs.

fields.tier: top1 = gold must be the #1 ranked skill; top3 = gold must appear in the top 3
fields.expectedSkillAny: gold skill labels; a match on any one passes
fields.expectedMode: optional; when set, the gold skill must be in COMPILED_ROUTING_HUBS and its compiled route must resolve action=route with a target workflowMode equal to this
fields.sourceCaseId: optional; provenance pointer to an existing corpus row (not re-authored here)

prompt: create a pull request on github
resolve merge conflict and rebase branch
save this conversation context to memory
create a new spec folder with plan and tasks
debug console errors in chrome devtools
notes: The corpus gold mcp-chrome-devtools is now served by the mcp-tooling hub; both labels accepted so the case survives the hub-identity merge.

prompt: write a README for this skill package
notes: Representative sk-doc (documentation authoring) case; clean top-1 in the pinned regime.

prompt: run deep research iterations until convergence
notes: Joined case: top-1 skill AND compiled route resolve to the research mode.

prompt: improve this prompt using the CLEAR framework
notes: Top-1 skill case: sk-prompt is a standalone skill, so there is no compiled route to join on.

prompt: scaffold a new parent skill hub with mode-registry
notes: 029 grok-high F22 observed sk-doc ranked #3 (behind sk-prompt and sk-code) against the full native graph+semantic advisor. Re-verified against the 002 pinned force-local regime on 2026-07-29: sk-doc is currently top-1 (0.680, ambiguous). Asserted as a top-3 regression floor (deliberately NOT top-1: tightening the ranking is 029 O6, out of scope here). sk-doc's create-skill-parent compiled route currently serves legacy, so the joined-mode assertion is deferred until re-mint.

prompt: Write a Vitest covering classifyPrompt() for the resume deep review phrase.
notes: Writing a test is code work even when the test is about a deep-review phrase. Before the code-authoring exemption the deep-review penalty put system-deep-loop first.

prompt: Resume the deep-review iteration from the last save point.
notes: Control for the case above: a real deep-review resume keeps the deep-review penalty on sk-code and routes to the review mode.

prompt: Add a packet-local helper that formats Gate 3 confusion-matrix rows for the research summary.
notes: Writing a helper is code work even when it formats study output. Before the code-authoring exemption the corpus-study bonus put system-spec-kit first.

prompt: Update the packet-local prompt template so future runs mention the confusion matrix requirement.
notes: Control for the case above: editing a study template keeps the corpus-study bonus.

prompt: Write a nested changelog for this packet
notes: A changelog request that names a packet routes to the changelog mode; the packet is only the source of the change history.

prompt: Create a packet changelog for the work I just finished
notes: Same class as the case above, carried by the sk-doc changelog phrases.

prompt: Write a packet-local changelog entry
notes: Before the changelog-from-packet exception the corpus-study bonus read packet-local as study vocabulary and put system-spec-kit first.

prompt: Create a changelog entry for this spec folder
notes: spec folder maxes the system-spec-kit explicit lane; the changelog-from-packet exception keeps sk-doc first.

prompt: Write a changelog for this packet
notes: Thinnest margin of the changelog-from-packet class: guards against a scoring shift that would hand it back to system-spec-kit.

prompt: Close out this spec folder: run completion validation and mark the packet done
notes: Control: spec-folder completion work stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: Generate the implementation summary for a finished spec packet
notes: Control: a spec-packet document stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: Re-render the existing per-packet change history files so they show the deprecation notice
notes: Control: per-packet history maintenance without a changelog-authoring verb stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: Create a spec folder for this feature
notes: Control: a create verb on a spec folder with no changelog stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: Validate this spec folder
notes: Control: spec-folder validation stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: Resume work on this spec packet
notes: Control: packet resume stays on system-spec-kit.

prompt: add a nested phase to the packet for the changelog work
notes: Control: the verb governs the phase, not the changelog, so the changelog-from-packet exception must not fire.

prompt: write the spec folder docs, including the changelog deprecation notice
notes: Control: the verb governs the spec folder docs; a changelog named later in the sentence stays spec-folder work.

prompt: save context for this packet, then write a changelog
notes: The changelog-from-packet exception adjusts only sk-doc and system-spec-kit, so the save-context bonus still reaches memory:save.

prompt: /speckit:plan create a changelog for this packet
notes: The changelog-from-packet exception adjusts only sk-doc and system-spec-kit, so the /speckit:plan bonus still reaches command-spec-kit.

prompt: how do I turn off the automatic worktree cleanup at session start
notes: The session-start numbered-worktree sweep is sk-git's; before sk-git declared its vocabulary the prompt tied three skills at the confidence floor.

prompt: disable the periodic session-start worktree cleanup
notes: Same feature as an imperative. A leading explain verb is held at the read-only explainer floor for every skill, so that phrasing is not pinned here.
